videos.script:
The planner has an address the host gave it. This lesson gives it one of your own, and the three things that come with it.

{{dns}} First the name. Two DNS records, and the one rule that catches everybody: the bare domain cannot be a CNAME. Then proving to the host that the domain is yours, and the record you must never leave behind when a site is gone.

{{tls}} Then HTTPS. What a certificate actually says, who signs it, and how a host gets one in seconds. You will make one yourself, for a name that exists only on your computer, and watch curl refuse it, then accept it.

{{redirects}} Then redirects. Which status code means what, and a rules file the host reads. The planner's host learns that file.

{{deep}} And the deep link from lesson 1. Typed into the address bar, it was a 404. You will see why the preview server hid it, and fix it on every host, including the one with no rules file at all.
